title: Detect dead panes and mark their tasks abandoned
done_when: A task whose target session's process is gone reaches a terminal 'abandoned' status, distinct from cancelled (deliberate) and overdue (still working); list_sessions reports pane liveness so a conductor can avoid dispatching into a dead pane; tests cover the transition. Observed again 2026-08-19: three of five panes finished their work and never called complete_task, leaving the conductor unable to tell finished-but-silent from still-working.
